ComponentLab/Drawer and commonWidget::Z_Drawer are the canonical design and SDK/Factory identities; commonWidget::Z_OverlayDrawer remains one explicitly recorded LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY implementation and Factory key, without adding a catalog identity. All 105 Widget/Composite identities are now instantiable and registered; this closes the canonical component engineering-count gap but does not imply visual approval or controller-level end-to-end completion. The public C++ Catalog exposes all 110 entries through designLibraryEntries while the component descriptor API remains component-only; ComponentLab uses this distinction for separate component, layout-helper and asset navigation. GenerateLayout validates and converts the two canonical LayoutHelper contracts and consumes 34 canonical components through the GenerateComponent SDK Factory. Menu, MenuBar, TabWidget and ToolBox use their public standalone Figma component nodes as GenerateLayout identities while MenuItem, MenuBarItem, TabItem and ToolBoxItem remain internal anatomy and variant sources; ToolBar consumes its 16 Figma variants and Show handle property through the shared SDK composition API. ComponentLab consumes SDK-owned public composition data for these navigation components, DockWidget and live MDI workspaces instead of owning duplicate constructors. DockWidget Area and Placement remain deterministic design previews and never mutate QMainWindow docking, floating, allowedAreas or feature flags. MdiSubWindow State remains paint metadata rather than one Qt enum, while MdiArea Free, Cascade and Tile remain authored geometry previews and only Tabbed maps to QMdiArea::TabbedView. Generated pages retain route synchronization, search execution, notification/profile data, bottom-navigation page routing, tab close confirmation, window layout lifecycle and persistence. Button, Checkbox and Input receive verified downstream status from the general downstreamEvidenceOverrides input rather than being under-reported as factory-only. All three Asset entries have public SDK catalogs and consumer chains: IconAsset uses stable icon IDs and QRC resolution, while ImageAsset and ModelAsset use VisualAssetCatalog for stateful SVG resolution, integrity metadata, high-DPI rendering and Profile token substitution. ComponentLab consumes the same catalogs and GenerateLayout stores only stable IDs and contracts, not parallel public paths. The current canonical component engineering gap is zero. The four standalone public component identities Menu, MenuBar, TabWidget and ToolBox are tracked separately from their internal variant-source sets.
